_meta.description: Round 3 review point 1 (openspec change round3-review-points). Ruben decided that a client's and a contact person's name, email and phone are edited on the client page and written back to the Nextcloud Contact (#2214, src/store/plugins/contactWriteBack.js). 15-unify-client-contact.json still declared them readOnly, and OpenRegister refuses any change to a readOnly property on update, so the Edit dialog failed with 'Cannot modify readOnly property: phone'. This fragment lifts readOnly on those three fields only. Address and website stay read-only mirrors: no form edits them. No property changes type and none becomes required.
